template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

cut_contour.note: Proposal: the source has no cut contour. Corner radius 4.2 mm is borrowed from the diefstal footer bar (4.23 mm); to be confirmed by the owner.

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of the source page (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
notes: 700 x 700 mm, no bleed in the source (page = trim, RGB ICC). The navy field is 700 x 516.1 mm and runs to the top and the sides (template: 3 mm into the bleed), the lower 183.9 mm is white paper (no ink, no white fill in the template). The reference keeps a navy rectangle (118.7 to 596.2 x 176.6 to 402.1 mm, #233A89) between the two bars: navy on navy, invisible, left out of the template. P+R symbol: py-comp-symbol-pr scaled 4.968x at 143.0 / 132.7 mm, the label P+R is live Ubuntu Bold 225.2 mm white (variable label-pr, source text is live). Price bubble: py-comp-price-bubble-speech MATCHES: the 17 control points of the source path equal the library bubble at scale 0.6797 and rotation -0.67 degrees (residual 0.44 mm rms), so it is placed (strip_text) with that scale and rotation. The price numerals are outlined in the source and rebuilt as live Ubuntu Bold, fitted by overlay (pixel overlap 0.99 / 0.94 / 0.97): '€6' 103.75 mm, ',-' 38.8 mm (a separate smaller text, the comma and hyphen are 37 percent of the price height in the source), 'per dag' 28.84 mm, all white, rotated -6.9 degrees (the library bubble text is rotated 6.7 degrees). Lockup: the garage symbol is py-comp-lockup-location-garage at scale 1.314 (symbol 133.7 mm wide), but the proportions of the library lockup do not hold here (name 49.8 mm against 46.7 mm at symbol width 101.8 in the library, name start 163.1 mm from the symbol edge against 140 mm, baseline pitch 49.8 mm): the name is drawn as own live text with strip_text, Ubuntu Bold 49.8 mm navy, two lines (Parking / Mandelapark, baselines 615.9 and 665.7 mm). The file blue #233A89 (RGB ICC) is the token navy in the template, light aqua #78C9DC (no token) is kept as sampled. Variables: label-pr, price, price-suffix, label, location-line-1, location-line-2, background-colour. The cut contour (ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm inside the trim, radius 4.2 mm) is a PROPOSAL: the source has none and the corner radius is borrowed from the diefstal sticker.
